{{Quote|Hr=SS
|Memories only weigh us down, but some pilgrims still cling to them with unseemly devotion. This memory isn't yours, but perhaps you could find some use for it?
|[[Mort]]}}

<b>Memory Lockets</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Upgrades|Items]] used to expand the capabilities of [[Crests]]. Each Crest starts with a different number of locked slots for {{CrestSlot|Red}}Red, {{CrestSlot|Blue}}Blue, and {{CrestSlot|Yellow}}Yellow [[Tools]], which can be unlocked by using Memory Lockets in the Crest menu. This can be done even if Hornet is not sitting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]].

== Use ==
Memory Lockets are used to unlock Tool slots in [[Crests]], allowing Hornet to equip more {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}, {{CrestSlot|Blue|s}}, and {{CrestSlot|Yellow|s}}.

After acquiring new Crests and unlocking more slots, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can speak to [[Eva]], who will grant her upgrades based on the current amount of slots unlocked, including [[Tools]] and [[Skills and Abilities (Silksong)#Silk Skills|Silk Skill]] slots. This does not count any slots from the [[Hunter Crest]], or any unused Memory Lockets in the inventory.
